name.value: Living Forest Oceanside Campground & RV Park

description.value: A large, year-round private campground on 53 acres where the Nanaimo River meets the harbour, with flush toilets, hot showers, a seasonal café, and miles of on-site trails; heavily RV-oriented with 300+ sites but tent spots are available right in the city's southern edge.

raw_osm.name: Living Forest Oceanside Campground & RV Park

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the campground's address (6 Maki Road, Nanaimo, BC V9R 6N7), phone ((250) 755-1755), and general features. Showers are confirmed via 'Beautiful clean showers' and token-operated details on the park rules page. Potable water is confirmed by 'pristine city water from the same mountain lakes.' Laundry is confirmed by the Wi-Fi page referencing the 'office/lounge/laundry building.' A seasonal café is on-site and shopping is a 5-minute walk away. Reservations are prominently offered. No explicit mention of hiker/biker sites, cyclist discounts, e-bike charging, covered shelter, drying area, animal-safe food storage, device charging, vending machines, ice, pump, tools, or camping fuel.
concerns: Website uses '+' in the name ('Campground + RV Park') while OSM uses '&'; retaining OSM spelling per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Large, well-established year-round campground in a cycling-friendly location on Vancouver Island with tent sites, showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, and easy access to transit and services—a strong fit for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: year-round ... flush toilets, hot showers, a seasonal café ... laundry
